args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Problem
The nightly build fails: `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212, but `src/money.py` was implemented with `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Fix
Change `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` (2.675 → 2.68, 2.665 → 2.66).

## Testing
CI run `ci-0001` on this branch passed.
